cards.ex: The international community is worried that the dictator is trigger-happy and might start a regional war.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro hamjamiyat diktatorning janjalkashligidan va mintaqaviy urush boshlashi mumkinligidan xavotirda.
cards.uzDef: Tezda tajovuzkorlik ko'rsatadigan yoki urushga tayyor odam haqida.

cards.ex: “No more war!” became the rallying cry of the anti-establishment movement.
cards.exUz: "Urushga yo'l yo'q!" anti-tizim harakatining shioriga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni bir maqsad yo'lida birlashtiruvchi shior yoki chaqiriq.

cards.ex: The corporation has built a massive war chest to fend off hostile takeovers.
cards.exUz: Korporatsiya dushmanlarning bosqinlaridan himoyalanish uchun katta urush xazinasi to'plagan.
cards.uzDef: Urush uchun ajratilgan katta miqdordagi pul yoki resurslar.

cards.ex: The hostage situation became a war of nerves for the families involved.
cards.exUz: Garovga olish holati unga aloqador oilalar uchun asablar urushiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Asabni qaqshatuvchi, zo'riqishga asoslangan kurash.

cards.ex: The UN sent a peace envoy to try to mediate between the warring factions.
cards.exUz: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti urushayotgan guruhlar o'rtasida vositachilik qilish uchun tinchlik elchisini yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlik o'rnatish uchun yuborilgan maxsus vakil.

cards.ex: She had to fight a battle with her insurance company to get the treatment she needed.
cards.exUz: U o'ziga kerakli davolanishni olish uchun sug'urta kompaniyasi bilan jang olib borishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun qattiq harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Their disagreement over the inheritance planted the seeds of discord within the family.
cards.exUz: Ularning meros bo'yicha kelishmovchiligi oila ichida nifoq urug'ini ekdi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik, urush sabab bo'luvchi holatlar.

cards.ex: The government launched a diplomatic offensive to gain support for its policies.
cards.exUz: Hukumat o'z siyosatini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun diplomatik hujum boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Xalqaro siyosatda maqsadingizga erishish uchun qilinadigan harakatlar.

cards.ex: His inflammatory speech only fanned the flames of racial tension in the city.
cards.exUz: Uning g'azabli nutqi shahardagi irqiy taranglik oloviga moy sepdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yomonlashtirmoq, ziddiyatni kuchaytirmoq.

cards.ex: It's best not to take sides in a family argument.
cards.exUz: Oila janjalida hech qanday tarafni tanlamaslik yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Bahsda yoki janjalda bir tarafni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: The two nations were on the brink of war after the border dispute.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat chegara mojarosidan keyin urush yoqasida edi.
cards.uzDef: Urush boshlanishiga juda yaqin holat, urush xavfi borligi.

cards.ex: Fighting flared up again in the region after a period of relative calm.
cards.exUz: Nisbatan tinchlik davridan so'ng, mintaqada janglar yana avj oldi.
cards.uzDef: Zo'ravonlik yoki mojaro birdan kuchayib ketishi.

cards.ex: The fragile truce is constantly threatened by violations from both sides.
cards.exUz: Mo'rt sulh har doim ikki tomonning buzilishi bilan tahdid ostida.
cards.uzDef: Oson buzilishi mumkin bo'lgan zaif sulh.

cards.ex: The journalists were in the trenches, reporting on the intense fighting.
cards.exUz: Jurnalistlar shiddatli janglar haqida xabar berib, xandaqlarda edi.
cards.uzDef: Urushning eng xavfli, oldingi safida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Europe was a major theater of war during World War II.
cards.exUz: Ikkinchi jahon urushi davrida Yevropa asosiy urush maydoni edi.
cards.uzDef: Urush harakatlari bo'layotgan joy yoki hudud.

cards.ex: The international community is calling for peace and an end to the violence.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro hamjamiyat tinchlik va zo'ravonlikka chek qo'yishga chaqirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlik o'rnatishga, urushni to'xtatishga chaqirish.

cards.ex: They've been at each other's throats ever since the election.
cards.exUz: Ular saylovdan beri bir-birlarini bo'g'ib kelishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablanib, qattiq janjallashmoq.

cards.ex: He tried to pour oil on troubled waters by mediating between the two sides.
cards.exUz: U ikki tomon o'rtasida vositachilik qilib, muammoli vaziyatni tinchlantirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni tinchlantirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Many citizens took up arms to defend their country against the invaders.
cards.exUz: Ko'p fuqarolar bosqinchilarga qarshi o'z mamlakatini himoya qilish uchun qurol oldi.
cards.uzDef: Urushda qatnashish uchun qurol olish.

cards.ex: The negotiations are on a knife-edge, and could collapse at any moment.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar juda xavfli holatda va har qanday vaqtda buzilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Juda nozik va o'zgaruvchan vaziyatda.

cards.ex: The rebels have dug in their heels and refuse to negotiate.
cards.exUz: Isyonchilar qaysarlik qilib, muzokara qilishdan bosh tortmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq qarshilik ko'rsatib, o'z pozitsiyasidan chekinmaslik.

cards.ex: She tried to take the moral high ground by condemning the violence.
cards.exUz: U zo'ravonlikni qoralab, o'zini axloqiy jihatdan to'g'ri tutishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini axloqiy jihatdan to'g'ri tutishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The country was placed on a war footing after the attack.
cards.exUz: Hujumdan so'ng mamlakat urush holatiga keltirildi.
cards.uzDef: Urushga tayyorgarlik ko'rish holati.

cards.ex: The soldiers managed to hold the line despite heavy enemy fire.
cards.exUz: Askarlar dushmanning qattiq o'qiga qaramay, pozitsiyani ushlab turishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Dushmanga qarshi turib, o'z pozitsiyasini saqlab qolish.

cards.ex: We might lose the battle on this particular issue, but we'll win the war in the long run.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu masalada jangda mag'lub bo'lishimiz mumkin, ammo uzoq muddatda urushda g'alaba qozonamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir vaziyatda yoki da'voda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash.

cards.ex: The international community needs to draw a line and make it clear that such actions are unacceptable.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro hamjamiyat chiziq tortishi va bunday harakatlar qabul qilinishi mumkin emasligini aniq ko'rsatishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirga yo'l qo'ymaslik to'g'risida qat'iy qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: She's on the warpath after discovering the lies.
cards.exUz: U yolg'onni bilib olgach, urush yo'lida.
cards.uzDef: Juda g'azablangan va janjallashishga tayyor.

cards.ex: “Freedom!” became the rallying cry of the revolution.
cards.exUz: "Ozodlik!" inqilobning birlashtiruvchi shioriga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashga va birgalikda harakat qilishga undaydigan shior.

cards.ex: International diplomats are trying to broker a ceasefire between the warring factions.
cards.exUz: Xalqaro diplomatlar urushayotgan tomonlar o'rtasida otashkesimga erishishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tomonlar o'rtasida otashkesim bo'yicha kelishuvga erishishga yordam berish.

cards.ex: The conflict has to run its course before any resolution is possible.
cards.exUz: Mojaro hal qilinishi mumkin bo'lishidan oldin o'z yo'liga qo'yilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning to'liq tugashiga imkon berish.
